purpose: The marketing site's own navigation: a sticky bar with the Azion mark, the mega-menu triggers and plain links, and the contact, login and sign-up actions, plus the sheet that carries the same tree below `xl`. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'site-nav', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `global-header`, `brand`, `navigation-menu`, `icon-button`, `search-trigger`, `button`, `drawer`, `panel-header`, `panel-footer`, `scroll-area` and `menu`. Each mega-menu lists its panel as columns of groups, and the sheet's drill-down tree is projected from the same menus, so an entry added to a panel is in both. The open state of the sheet, its drill path and the bar's inline inset are local state. Search is the folded `search-trigger` last in the bar: the section owns no palette, it emits `search` (on a click and on ⌘K / Ctrl K) and the page opens its own `command`, as every header does under `rules/webkit-header-search.md`.
useWhen: At the top of every marketing page, once.
avoidWhen: For the Console's application header → use `global-header` directly.
For an in-page list of links → use `navigation-menu` or `menu` directly.
related: global-header` — the bar primitive the navigation is rendered in.
navigation-menu` — the mega-menu the bar opens from `xl` up.
menu` — the drill-down tree the sheet carries below `xl`.
bestPractices: Keep a panel to one, two or four columns; only the four-column panel is stretched to the page column.
Stack a short group under another in the same column (Platform under Observe) instead of adding a fifth column.
Give every entry an `href`; an entry without one links to `#`.
Listen to `search` and open the page's `Command` from it (`@search="searchOpen = true"` beside `<Command v-model:open="searchOpen">`); the trigger already carries ⌘K / Ctrl K.
Leave `secondaryActionOnPhones` off: on a phone the bar keeps the menu button, the mark, the call to action and search, as azion.com does, and Login stays in the sheet footer.
The bar is `--layout-header-height` tall: `HeroBand` already takes it out of a screen-filling band; a bare `Hero kind="screen"` takes `offset="var(--layout-header-height)"`, never a literal length.
Don't wrap the bar, add a second search button beside it, or bind ⌘K yourself.
